propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB, with 92% consisting of the reconciler's .bridge_state cache rather than ticket event data; consecutive bindings.json revisions show 1144 changes per pass to baseline_advanced_at which is never read in src/.

A scattered edit across the 18 MB sorted bindings.json defeats git delta compression; measured marginal pack cost per version is 12.79 KB today but would be 1.74 KB (7.4x) after removing the timestamp and 12.8x smaller with rotation bookkeeping moved out.

The .bridge_state cache must remain committed on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners requiring durable state in git; deleting baseline_advanced_at, moving last_get_pass to get_rotation.json, and normalizing baseline text will reduce churn without changing location.

A stock git fast-export/filter/fast-import history rewrite reduces the existing repository from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and restoring the current .bridge_state files identically at HEAD.

Rollout gates are operator-attested descendant reconciler workflow execution plus explicit host refresh for A2-2, and descendant workflow plus live epoch-refusal probes from review-bot and host runtimes for the reclaim, rather than fixed time delays.

Post-publish rollback requires a second quiesced window with workflow disable, bundle verification, forced ref restoration with --force-with-lease, and mandatory re-clone of all writers to fail-closed on epoch mismatch rather than override.
